resources.string: Service running — new screenshots go to the clipboard, then you choose whether to keep the file
After each screenshot a notification asks whether to keep the file. Tap Keep and it stays. Do nothing and it is deleted when the countdown ends — the clipboard copy is unaffected either way.
Notifications are blocked, so the keep prompt cannot be shown and screenshots will be deleted without asking. Grant notification access to be able to keep files.
Pick a folder on internal storage — SD cards and cloud folders are not supported
No folder picker available on this device
Open Settings › Apps › Screenshot Clipboard and allow access to all files
Tip: some manufacturers (Xiaomi, Samsung, etc.) block auto-start after reboot. If monitoring does not resume after a reboot, enable auto-start for this app in system settings.
